decisions.reason: It extends the firm's established dumper know-how and its continued full product-page presence through 2024 suggests enough market traction for the firm to keep refining it through its existing engineering and service capabilities.
As an articulated construction dumper closely rooted in the firm's existing competence base, it fits high absorptive capacity and remained actively marketed in 2024, supporting continuation.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is distant from the firm's core knowledge base and was downgraded from a dedicated page to only a mention in 2024, the firm is less able to learn and improve it efficiently and should reallocate resources.
The compact telescopic loader builds on familiar product and application knowledge, and its continued standalone presentation indicates it remains a viable platform for incremental improvement.

This material lift is close to the established offer and already shows strong demand evidence through a large order and longstanding rental popularity, making it an attractive product to develop further.

Although more distant from the core range, the mining loader shows strong early field performance after seven months, and with the firm's in-house R&D and underground-equipment capabilities it is worth retaining and learning from.
